create_chroma_client: create a ChromaClient instance to connect to a Chroma vector database via HTTP or persistent storage
search_vector_collection: search a Chroma collection using vector embeddings with optional filters and result limits
insert_vector_items: insert vector items with text, embeddings, and metadata into a Chroma collection with automatic batching
upsert_vector_items: upsert vector items into a Chroma collection, updating existing entries and inserting new ones
delete_collection_items: delete items from a Chroma collection by specific IDs or by metadata filter
